name: The Violet-Flora Strata
description: A sudden biological re-coding within the Southern-Verdant-Buffer has introduced an invasive, purple-pigmented phenotype. These humanoid-patterned growths are disrupting the local ecological-registry, forcing the Atlas Confederation to deploy field agents to stabilize the terraforming-layers before the shift becomes permanent.

definitions.name: Elara Voss-Kalu
definitions.description: A high-level ecological-registrar with skin stained by violet-spore exposure; she manages the biological records of the buffer-zone.
definitions.role: The violet phenotype in a human shape: the look the drifting humanoids of the Strata take.

artBrief.silhouette: Upright figure with a long coat, entirely violet.
artBrief.detail: Magenta skin and coat with purple shading; spore stains darker than the coat.
artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Elara Voss-Kalu
definitions.description: An ecological registrar the violet spores changed; her shape now walks the Strata many times over.
definitions.role: The hostile face of the saga: the divergent humanoids survivors must neutralize.
definitions.voice: Fragments of registry entries, spoken as if the forest were listening.

definitions.name: Jiro Samsara-Lin
definitions.description: A veteran Atlas-security-contractor specialized in managing non-compliant botanical-growth.
definitions.role: The look of the Atlas surveyor who leads the buffer audit.

artBrief.silhouette: Figure in a field coat with a survey pack.
artBrief.detail: Grey field coat, warm skin tone and a worn surveyor badge.
artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Jiro Samsara-Lin
definitions.description: A veteran Atlas security contractor who surveys the buffer and reports how far the violet growth has spread.
definitions.role: The quest giver who starts the saga with the buffer drift survey.
definitions.voice: Tired field professional; badge still works, just.
definitions.placement: Provider. Place at the edge of the foliage expanse.

definitions.name: Knot-Node Terminal
definitions.description: A decommissioned environmental-control terminal at the Sap-Logic Array, now the interface for coordinating node neutralization.
definitions.role: The body of the array terminal that coordinates node neutralization.

artBrief.silhouette: Boxy standing terminal with a screen.
artBrief.detail: Grey casing, green screen text and dark cable roots.
artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Knot-Node Terminal
definitions.description: A decommissioned environmental-control terminal of the array, awake again and asking for help.
definitions.role: The machine voice that sends survivors after the growth nodes.
definitions.voice: System notices in capitals, then short requests.
definitions.placement: Provider. Place inside the array; it does not move.

definitions.name: Vossen-Khyber
definitions.description: Elara Vossen-Khyber, the Atlas perimeter officer overseeing the reinforcement of the buffer's boundary lines.
definitions.role: The look of the Atlas perimeter officer of the buffer.

artBrief.silhouette: Broad figure in a reinforced coat with a raised collar.
artBrief.detail: Indigo-tinted bark plates over a yellow Atlas coat; a signal lamp on the shoulder.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Atlas yellow, indigo bark, dark leather.
artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Elara Vossen-Khyber
definitions.description: The Atlas perimeter officer who reinforces the boundary of the buffer.
definitions.role: The provider of perimeter hardening and the seller of suppression gear.
definitions.voice: Terse warnings about the canopy and the root-works.
definitions.placement: Provider. Place at the buffer boundary.

definitions.name: Thon-Zheng
definitions.description: Kaelen Thon-Zheng, a border-watch fabricator who barters reclaimed bark-composite gear for salvage.
definitions.role: The look of the border-watch fabricator.

artBrief.silhouette: Figure in an apron with a tool belt.
artBrief.detail: Scorched apron, welding goggles pushed up, bark offcuts in the belt.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Soot greys, leather browns, indigo offcuts.
artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Kaelen Thon-Zheng
definitions.description: A border-watch fabricator who barters reclaimed bark-composite gear for salvage.
definitions.role: The crafter of the saga and the provider of the final reclamation.
definitions.voice: Wary trader; warns that Atlas is watching the borders.

definitions.name: Spore Suppressor Slugger
definitions.description: A pneumatic tool designed to drive off aggressive, mutagen-heavy vegetation with high-pressure bursts.
definitions.role: The tool-weapon Atlas field agents use against aggressive growth.

artBrief.silhouette: Short wide-barrel launcher with a tank.
artBrief.detail: Pneumatic tank on the side, a flared muzzle stained violet.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Worn steel, Atlas yellow grip, violet stains.
artBrief.spriteScale: Held by a 2×2 cell character; drawn over its skin.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Spore Suppression Volley
definitions.description: Fires a suppressant projectile toward the target. Spawn chance and lifetime scale with Intelligence and Range.
definitions.role: The ranged attack of the spore suppressor slugger.

definitions.name: Biometric Masking Array
definitions.description: A tactical adjustment that mimics the biological signature of the local violet-flora.
definitions.role: What the spore suppressor slugger fires.

artBrief.detail: Green-violet mist around a bright core.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)

definitions.name: Violet Growth Knot
definitions.description: A dense, pulsating mass of purple-pigmented biomass that obstructs navigation through the undergrowth.
definitions.role: The growth nodes that anchor the violet phenotype; they block paths and are harvested once neutralized.

artBrief.silhouette: Round knotted mass low to the ground.
artBrief.detail: Pulsing violet veins through dark green fibers.

definitions.placement: Blocks movement. Cluster in the undergrowth and around array walls.

definitions.name: Purplish Sap Vial
definitions.description: A viscous, violet fluid harvested from the rogue biomass, used in improvised biological stabilizers.
definitions.role: The sample the buffer survey asks for, and an ingredient of bark plating.

artBrief.detail: Glass vial full of violet sap with a cork.
artBrief.spriteScale: One cell; drawn as an inventory icon and a dropped item.

definitions.name: Drained Sap Vial
definitions.description: A viscous, violet fluid harvested from the rogue biomass, used in improvised biological stabilizers.
definitions.role: The depleted state of a sap source after its vial is taken.

artBrief.detail: Empty glass with a violet film at the bottom.

definitions.name: Composite Bark Plating
definitions.description: Protective gear fashioned from the hardened, indigo-hued stems of the local flora.
definitions.role: The armor Atlas deploys along the buffer, crafted from growth knots and sap.

artBrief.silhouette: Chest plate of layered bark strips.
artBrief.detail: Indigo bark strips bound with cord over a padded vest.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
